comparison.startup_cash: $600-$1,000: Amboras Basic $49/mo, samples/test orders $100-$250, UGC $200-$600, first Meta test $400 (CLAUDE.md budget). No inventory.
comparison.typical_margin: Thin. US-warehouse dropship landed cost is typically 1.5-2.5x factory price (ASSUMED, not sourced); after Meta CPA ($38.51 pets to $51.86 electronics, Triple Whale) most sub-$80 AOV kits are at or below break-even on first order; profit comes from repeat/upsell.
comparison.cash_flow: Good: customer pays first (Stripe payout ~2 business days, new accounts may be held), supplier paid per order; ads are prepaid daily.
comparison.risk: High CAC risk on $400 test (8-10 purchases at median CPA, not enough to judge); US dropship suppliers' stock/quality/blind-shipping unreliable; FTC shipping-time liability; low barrier, easy to copy.
comparison.virality_fit: Medium: viral video drives traffic to own site, but off-platform click-out loses many impulse buyers vs in-app checkout.
comparison.scale_path: Meta/TikTok ads scale linearly with budget; at $10k/month profit you need high contribution per order (>$15 after ads) and ~700+ orders/month; needs capital beyond $1,800 (milestone 2 needs $1.5k-$2.25k ad spend per CLAUDE.md).
comparison.evidence: Meta CPA medians Aug 2025-Jul 2026 (Triple Whale); CLAUDE.md sales check showed cheap bundles don't earn premium price.

comparison.startup_cash: $900-$1,400: 10-50 units air express ($10-16/kg) + duties ~23-41% for China goods + samples + packaging + store + $400 ads.
comparison.time_to_first_sale: 4-7 weeks (factory sample, production, 3-7 day air express, store).
comparison.typical_margin: Best unit margin of any DTC path (factory COGS + air + duty, USPS GA $8-$12 for 1-2 lb zones 4-6), but same Meta CAC wall.
comparison.cash_flow: Pay for inventory upfront (cash tied 4-8 weeks); 10-50 unit cap limits loss.
comparison.risk: Inventory risk small (capped batch); tariff volatility (12.5% forced-labor 301 added Jul 24 2026); owner ships every order (time); quality control is in his hands (an advantage).
comparison.virality_fit: Medium: same click-out problem as model 1, but real product in hand for genuine demo videos (required by CLAUDE.md).
comparison.scale_path: Self-ship works to ~100 orders; then 3PL ($4.50-$7.40/order excl. shipping) or FBT/FBA; reorder by sea.
comparison.evidence: USPS Notice 123 (Oct 4 2026); forwarder air rates 2026; China Briefing tariff stack (Jul 24 2026).

comparison.startup_cash: $3,000-$10,000 realistic (inventory 200-500 units to rank and avoid stock-outs, inbound freight, Vine $200 + 30 free units, launch PPC, trademark, photos). $1,800 covers a micro-launch at best.
comparison.time_to_first_sale: 8-14 weeks (production, freight to FBA, check-in, listing).
comparison.typical_margin: 15% referral + FBA $5.57-$6.67 (1.5-3 lb, +3.5% surcharge, rising Jan 15 2027) + storage + PPC CPA ($13.10 pets, $17.76 home & garden, $25.02 electronics for established brands). Healthy only at $40+ price with low COGS.
comparison.cash_flow: Worst: inventory + freight paid 2-3 months before sales; Amazon pays every ~14 days with DD+7 reserve.
comparison.risk: Copycats and price wars, review cold start, account suspensions, 2027 fee increases (+$0.19 avg, low-inventory fee, aged storage), stock-outs kill rank.
comparison.virality_fit: Low-medium: Amazon search intent rewards rank and reviews, not 3-second wow; external TikTok traffic to Amazon helps but is not tracked well.
comparison.scale_path: Proven path to $10k+/month once a SKU ranks; best as phase 2 for a product already proven on TikTok/DTC (Amazon demand search is the long tail of virality).
comparison.evidence: Amazon fee pages and Goat Consulting 2026/2027 tables; Triple Whale Amazon CPA medians; Vine fee tiers.

comparison.typical_margin: Saves FBA fee but pays own USPS ($8-$12 for 1-2 lb) + 15% referral; similar or worse per-order than FBA for light items.
comparison.cash_flow: Better than FBA (small batch), same Amazon payout cadence.
comparison.risk: No Prime badge: agencies report 20-40% lower conversion; new listing with no reviews + no Prime rarely ranks; strict late-shipment/cancel metrics; Amazon prepaid return labels mandatory.
comparison.scale_path: Only as a test of Amazon demand or for heavy/oversize items; move to FBA once proven.
comparison.evidence: FBA vs FBM conversion estimates (vendor-sourced); SFP 2026 speed rules.

comparison.model: 5. TikTok Shop seller (self-ship small batch, later FBT/3PL) + creator affiliates
comparison.startup_cash: $700-$1,300: small batch 30-50 units, 20-30 creator samples ($15-$75 each incl. shipping), own AI-twin/UGC videos; no monthly fee.
comparison.time_to_first_sale: 3-6 weeks (shop approval, product listing approval, samples, first creator videos).
comparison.typical_margin: Referral 6% published / 8% reported since Aug 4 2026 (incl. payment) + affiliate 10-18% only on sales + shipping + returns (10-18% in home/electronics). Combined take ~25-30% of price (FastMoss), but acquisition is variable, not prepaid.
comparison.cash_flow: Slow for new sellers: 31-day settlement after delivery plus possible 30-day reserve; inventory and samples are paid upfront. Plan for ~5-7 weeks of float.
comparison.risk: Policy churn (shipping mandate on/off, fee rise to 8%), US regulatory risk to TikTok, platform dependency, returns, account-health score; creator content is uneven (60-80% of samples may yield no video per GRIN).
comparison.virality_fit: Highest: in-feed checkout turns a 3-second wow into a purchase without click-out; US TikTok Shop GMV $15.8B 2025 -> ~$23.4B 2026 forecast.
comparison.scale_path: Affiliates + GMV Max ($50-$200/day) scale on proof; move to FBT ($2.86-$4.28/unit) or 3PL after ~100 orders; reach $10k/month profit at roughly 1,000-1,500 orders/month at $8-$10 contribution after commissions (illustrative).
comparison.evidence: FastMoss (Jun 2026) fee/commission data; Delzonic 8% report; SFN commission ranges; eMarketer GMV forecast.

comparison.model: 6. TikTok Shop affiliate creator only (AI twin/UGC, no inventory)
comparison.startup_cash: $0-$200 (AI twin/voice tooling; free samples from sellers).
comparison.time_to_first_sale: 2-8 weeks: need 1,000 followers to self-apply (30-day pilot under 5,000).
comparison.typical_margin: Commission 5-20% of others' GMV (US avg ~13%); no COGS, no fees. Earnings are highly skewed; no reliable median found.
comparison.cash_flow: Commissions paid after order completion/return window; no outlay.
comparison.risk: No asset/brand built; AI content must carry disclosure; some brands ban AI content; CLAUDE.md forbids an AI person claiming to have used the product, which removes the dominant 'I tried it' format; GMV Max AI videos are eroding affiliate income (Shopifreaks).
comparison.virality_fit: High, and it is a zero-cost way to learn which hooks and products convert in the target niches.
comparison.scale_path: $10k/month needs ~$75k+/month of attributed GMV at 13%; possible for top accounts, not a plan. Best used as a research and audience-building lane that later sells the own product.
comparison.evidence: Affiliate eligibility policy reviewed Aug 2026; commission averages; AI-avatar reporting 2026.

comparison.typical_margin: 17-29% after ads on Printify's own examples; Etsy fees ~9.5-10% + 15% offsite ads on attributed sales.
comparison.risk: Commoditised, IP/trademark complaints, low AOV, quality control remote.
comparison.virality_fit: Low for the brief's niches: POD products (shirts, mugs, posters) rarely have a 3-second physical wow; ceramic mugs are excluded as fragile.
comparison.scale_path: Many designs x low margin; $10k/month profit is rare and design-volume heavy.
comparison.evidence: Printify and calculator examples 2026; Etsy fee schedule.

comparison.risk: Brand gating, IP complaints (retail receipts no longer accepted for ungating per 2026 reports), Buy Box competition; builds no brand.
comparison.scale_path: Linear with capital; $10k/month profit needs ~$50k-$70k/month of revenue and matching working capital.

comparison.model: 9. Multi-channel hybrid: TikTok Shop for discovery + Amboras DTC for bundles/repeat + Amazon FBA later
comparison.startup_cash: $1,000-$1,600 within the $1,800 (small batch + samples + Amboras + small retargeting budget).
comparison.typical_margin: TikTok Shop orders: commission-based acquisition; DTC orders: no marketplace fee (3.9% payment+platform) for repeat/refill/email buyers and searchers created by viral videos; Amazon later captures search demand.
comparison.cash_flow: Mixed: DTC pays fast, TikTok slow (31 days new seller); keep 3 weeks of reserve per CLAUDE.md.
comparison.risk: Spread too thin if launched all at once; inventory split across channels; mitigated by sequencing (one channel at a time).
comparison.virality_fit: Highest overall: virality monetised in-app, then captured off-platform.
comparison.scale_path: TikTok Shop proves demand -> FBT/3PL -> DTC kit builder + refills (Dhruv's software edge) -> Amazon FBA for search demand -> Walmart (approval easier with sales history).
comparison.evidence: Combination of above; mirrors the Quad Lock/Blueland accessory-refill lesson in CLAUDE.md.

best_combinations.name: A (recommended): TikTok Shop seller + Amboras DTC, small batch self-shipped
best_combinations.how: Air-express 30-50 units of a hero kit to home; list on TikTok Shop (3% new-seller rate for 30 days); seed 20-30 creators at 12-18% open/targeted commission; post Dhruv's AI-twin/voiceover demo videos (disclosed, no 'I used it' claims) from the shop account; Amboras store carries the full kit/bundle builder, refills and email capture; Meta only for retargeting. After ~100 orders move to FBT or a 3PL, reorder by sea; add Amazon FBA once reviews/sales prove demand.
best_combinations.why: Acquisition cost is a % of each sale instead of a prepaid Meta CPA of ~$39-$52, so the $1,800 buys inventory and creator reach rather than 8-10 ad-bought customers.
best_combinations.watch: 31-day new-seller settlement; 8% referral reported; shipping-policy churn; refund rate 10-18% in home/electronics.

best_combinations.name: B (zero-inventory warm-up, run in parallel): TikTok Shop affiliate account -> own product
best_combinations.how: For 4-8 weeks, run an AI-twin/voiceover affiliate account in the chosen niche promoting other sellers' products that ship from US warehouses; use real commission data to see which hooks and price points convert; carry the followers and the winning formats into the own shop launch.
best_combinations.why: Costs ~$0, gives real sales evidence for the 'hero first' rule and builds the audience the own product launches into.
best_combinations.watch: 1,000-follower gate; AI disclosure; must not claim personal use.

best_combinations.name: C (later scale stack): TikTok Shop + Amazon FBA + DTC refills
best_combinations.how: Once a product sells 300+/month on TikTok Shop, open Amazon FBA with Brand Registry (10% back on first $50k, $200 Vine credit, $400 inbound credit) to capture search demand that the videos create; DTC holds subscriptions/refills.
best_combinations.why: Viral products generate Amazon search spillover; Amazon PPC CPA medians ($13.10 pets, $17.76 home & garden) are far below Meta's.
best_combinations.watch: 2027 FBA increases (+$0.19 avg Jan 15 2027; low-inventory fee and aged storage from Feb 1 2027).
